evidence.previous_paragraph: As the dust settled, revealing the untaxed loot and confirming the exploit's success, Rhea walked over to the rubble. She gathered the Scavenger Carapaces and the Copper Credits, slipping them into her pockets with a grim smile. The math was finally on their side.
evidence.current_paragraph: With the untaxed loot gathered—specifically the raw Scavenger Carapaces now shoved safely into her left blazer pocket alongside her obsidian shard and ash fungus—the group stood in the settling dust of the Collapsed Transit Tunnel to discuss formalizing their ad-hoc party into a binding System contract.
